title: State encoding
statement: For Boolean lists $c$ and $w$ and a list $v$ of natural numbers, define their encoded state by pairing $c$ with the result of pairing $w$ with the pair encoding of a list of $|v|$ true values and the encoding of the list of binary representations of the entries of $v$.
